name: Thai coconut & veg broth
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical broth/noodle soup recipes with 1L stock + 400ml coconut milk + 175g noodles + vegetables, commonly serving 4 adults.

Preparation time summed from instruction steps (1min fry + 3min simmer + 4-6min simmer) using the minimum 4min for the second simmer, rounded up to nearest 5min increment for total active/passive time; excludes any unlisted prep like chopping.
Thai red curry paste assumed to contain no fish/anchovy (common vegetarian brand variation) but uncertain without specific brand; Fish allergen left null.
Chinese leaf treated as Napa cabbage (standard equivalent).
Egg noodles confirmed as containing egg and wheat from dietary note and common composition.
No dairy, peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish, sesame, or soy explicitly present; soy left null due to possible presence in curry paste or stock.
Spring onions, coriander, lime, tomatoes, carrots, bean sprouts, oil, sugar, and stock are compatible with all listed diets except where blocked by noodles.
instructions:
step 1
Place the curry paste in a large saucepan or wok with the oil. Fry for 1 min until fragrant. Tip in the vegetable stock, coconut milk and brown sugar. Simmer for 3 mins.

step 2
Add the noodles, carrots and Chinese leaf and simmer for 4-6 mins, until all are tender. Mix in beansprouts and tomatoes. Add lime juice to taste and some extra seasoning, if you like. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with spring onions and coriander.

ingredients.name: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Typical Thai red curry paste; ~22g for 1.5 tbsp based on common jar density (~15g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Vegetable Stock
ingredients.assumptions: Vegetable stock/broth; 1 L assumed as 1000 g with low-calorie vegetable base (common carton values).

ingredients.name: Coconut Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Coconut milk; standard full-fat canned value for 400 ml can (≈400 g).

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Brown sugar; 2 tsp ≈ 8 g (standard granulated density).

ingredients.name: Egg Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Dried egg noodles; direct 175 g as listed (typical dry wheat/egg noodle profile).

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: Carrots; 2 medium carrots ≈ 120 g total (edible raw weight).

ingredients.name: Chinese Leaf
ingredients.assumptions: Chinese leaf (Napa cabbage); 1/2 medium head ≈ 350 g edible portion.

ingredients.name: Bean Sprouts
ingredients.assumptions: Bean sprouts (mung); direct 150 g as listed (raw).

ingredients.name: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Cherry tomatoes; 6 medium ≈ 90 g total (edible raw).

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.assumptions: Lime juice; juice of 1 lime ≈ 40 g (standard yield, no peel).

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: Spring onions; 3 sliced ≈ 45 g total (edible raw weight).

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh coriander (cilantro); handful ≈ 15 g (typical garnish amount).
